changes.description: Ports by change status; null without a previous scan

title: SubSurf scan result
description: result.json: one scan run, nested subnet → host → port

hosts.description: Hosts that responded, failed to scan or disappeared; silent addresses are only counted

probe_attempts.description: Repeated measurements of an unstable host within this scan

os.description: Nmap OS detection (-O); null when disabled

state.description: `not_reported`: requested but absent from Nmap output

method.description: `table`: guessed from the port number only

hostname.description: Sent as HTTP Host and TLS SNI; null when the service was addressed by its IP

Endpoint.description: One port seen under one name (virtual host)

accepted_versions.description: Versions accepted when probed one by one; empty when not probed

hostname_matches.description: Against the endpoint hostname; null: none

redirects.description: In order; the final response is not a hop

redirect_stop_reason.description: Why the chain was cut short; null when it ended on its own

cookies.description: Set anywhere along the redirect chain

headers.description: In received order with duplicates; Set-Cookie is parsed into `cookies` instead

truncated.description: The excerpt is shorter than the body

excerpt.description: Start of the body as text, for HTML-fragment and footer-version signatures

mmh3.description: MurmurHash3 of the base64-encoded icon, as Shodan computes it

PathProbe.description: Safe detection only: GET/HEAD, no credentials, no request body

hostname.description: Endpoint the evidence comes from; null: the IP

key.description: Header or cookie name, probed path, certificate field
Stable across scans: the diff and DefectDojo deduplication key

Interest.description: Analytical priority, higher is more worth a look

is_unstable.description: Responded only in some of the recent scans

Diff.description: Comparison with `scan.previous_scan_id`, filled in by the backend; absent in worker output
